notes.title: v25.07.12 - Update
notes.content:
I'm happy to share that I've brought in a native American English speaker / proofreader to help make the English puzzles even more natural and enjoyable.



From now on, all puzzles in the game are either written or reviewed by native speakers in both Hungarian and English, so you can expect the best possible experience—no matter which language you choose to play in.



Thank you for playing,

RapidAnt

notes.title: v25.06.03 - Update
notes.content:
With this update, the game now includes the ability to create your own private riddles using the built-in riddle editor.
In addition, it also contains several smaller improvements such as new riddles, themes, and background music.

Riddle Editor:

 	Support for creating your own custom riddles.
 	Intelligent riddle editor that assists in creating valid riddles.
 	Support for creating, editing, and deleting riddles within the editor.
 	Supported riddle board sizes: from 2×2×2 up to 4×4×5

 	 	Maximum supported number of categories: 5
 	 	Maximum supported items per category: 5
 	Custom title and story can be added to each riddle.
 	Support for adding custom images to riddles. (non-native method)
 	Language support for riddles:
 	 	Currently supports English / Hungarian / Other languages, and more will be added based on demand.
 	Unlimited number of statements / clues can be added to each riddle.
 	Support for displaying category items in a user-defined order in the riddles.

		
Other Improvements:

 	New riddles in English and Hungarian.
 	Performance optimization for riddle loading.
 	New filters for custom riddles and other languages.
 	New background music.
 	New purple theme.
 	Updated Credits section for music and language proofreading.

		
Bug Fixes:

 	Text corrections in existing riddles
 	Color and UI-related fixes in themes and interface elements

notes.title: v25.02.21 - Update
notes.content:
Dear Players!

A new update has arrived!
The game is continuously evolving, and with each update, I strive to bring new features, improvements, and fixes.
While development takes a lot of time and effort, my goal is to provide you with the best possible experience.
Thank you for your support and feedback – you play a huge role in making the game even better!

What's new?

New Features:

     SmartFill improvement: The game now detects when a puzzle is sufficiently solved and offers an option for automatic completion or manual fill-in.
     Marker placement on the game board – you can now right-click to mark important or uncertain connections!
     Stars displayed above in-game images – this helps you see what the final outcome will look like once the puzzle is solved.
     Preparations for the "Custom Riddle Editor" in the full version – soon, you'll be able to create your own puzzles (for now, just for personal use)!


New Riddles:

     2x6 new puzzles added to the full game for even more challenges.


Quality of Life Improvements:

     Reset filters with one button press when selecting puzzles!


User Interface:

     Fine-tuned UI color themes for several elements.
     Replaced dropdown arrows with better icons.
     Added game logo to the in-game screen.


Bug Fixes:

     Minor fixes related to sounds and UI elements.


Many exciting updates are still in the works, and I am continuously improving the game to make it the best it can be.
Thank you for being here, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: v25.02.02 - Update
notes.content:
Steam Cloud support has arrived in the game!

I’m excited to announce that Steam Cloud support is now available in the game!

This isn’t just the usual cloud save feature - I’ve put extra effort into ensuring that players with multiple Steam accounts can use it seamlessly on the same computer.
So, you don’t have to worry about your saves or progress getting mixed up.

Great news:
Steam Cloud support works not only on Windows but also on Steam Deck!
From now on, you can start playing on your desktop and continue on your Steam Deck while traveling - without interruption.

Upcoming feature: Offline profile selection is coming!

Currently, offline saves are handled separately, but an upcoming update will allow you to choose which profile you want to use when launching the game on the same machine.

I’m working on making the experience even more convenient!

Enjoy the game,
RapidAnt

notes.title: v25.01.28 - Update
notes.content:
Although I did not post about it, I have made many improvements to the game since the demo first release, based on player feedback in several aspects, including new functions, riddles, and quality-of-life enhancements.

As a result of the player feedback now I added the ability to save the riddle filters as a Quality Of Life improvement.

Moreover if the language setting was modified in the settings menu, it will now be automatically applied to the riddle filters also (so even one less click) :)

A quick note: 
Filters that come from the tutorial menu won't be saved (except language setting), because tutorial menu is itself contains a premade filter set.

I hope this new update is well received,  brings you more convenience, and makes the game even better. :)
